scope_note: Corporate equities ALONE (no mutual funds). RESIDUAL: all-sectors total minus 21 other identified holder lines (incl. the separate 'Hedge funds (domestic)' line, split out since 2012:Q4 per the current table footnote -- publicly documented Sept 2020). THE brief's headline series: sums to $3,069.4bn, 2024:Q1-2026:Q2. EXACT COMPUTED FORMULA, from the Fed's own Financial Accounts Guide Series Analyzer (https://www.federalreserve.gov/apps/fof/SeriesAnalyzer.aspx?s=FU153064105) fetched live for this task: FU153064105 = FU893064105 (all sectors) MINUS FU693064105 (non-MMF investment funds, incl. hedge funds/MF/ETF/CEF/BDC/private debt rolled up) MINUS FU663064105 (brokers-dealers) MINUS FU503064105 (other financial business) MINUS FU763064103 (US-chartered depositories) MINUS FU583064105 (insurance cos. and pension funds) MINUS FU263064105 (rest of world) MINUS FU103064103 (nonfinancial corporate business) MINUS FU753064103 (foreign banking offices) MINUS FU213064103 (state/local govts) MINUS FU313064105 (federal govt) MINUS FU713064103 (central bank). 11 subtracted terms at this level of aggregation (each itself a sum of the ~21 detail lines seen in the P1 netbuyers table). This series in turn feeds FU153064475 (directly+indirectly held corporate equities) = FU153064105 + FU153064175 (indirectly held via mutual funds/DC pensions/annuities) -- FU153064475 is the ~$74.0trn 'Table 1' concept in the Sept-2026 Recent Developments page, confirming it is a STRICTLY BROADER aggregate than our $3,069.4bn/$52.1trn figure, not an alternative measurement of the same thing.
